items.title: AFCS: The Flight Control Stack
items.description: How the AW169 EP's Automatic Flight Control System is built up layer by layer, followed through a real departure and approach to show how the modes actually work together in flight.

items.title: ADELT: Automatic Ejection of Emergency Beacons
items.description: How the ADELT crash position indicator works, followed through a real ditching and crash sequence to show what happens automatically versus what the pilot does.

items.title: TCAS II: Vertical Escape Geometry
items.description: How TCAS II actually thinks, followed through a real traffic encounter from first contact to clear of conflict.

items.title: HTAWS: Managing the Flying Data Center
items.description: How the terrain awareness and warning system thinks, followed through a real terrain event from first alert to resolution.

items.title: Fire: Protection and Emergency Procedures
items.description: How the fire detection and extinguishing system is built, followed through a real engine fire from first indication to a safe outcome.

items.title: Electrical: Failure Logic and Survival
items.description: How the electrical system generates, converts, and distributes power, followed through a real generator failure to show exactly how the system protects itself and what the pilot does.

items.title: Limitations: Operational and Structural Flight Limits
items.description: A complete walkthrough of every operating limitation for the AW169 EP — weight, speed, rotor, engine, and system limits — with a brief note on why each one is set where it is.
